description: Capture screenshots of the entire page or specific elements

encoded.description: Whether to return the screenshot as a base64 encoded data URL

height.description: Optional viewport height in pixels for the screenshot

name.description: The name to store the screenshot under

selector.description: Optional CSS selector of the element to screenshot; the full page is captured when omitted

width.description: Optional viewport width in pixels for the screenshot
